dataLifecycle.retention: unlimited — evidence and configuration only; each functional unit's MariaDB rows follow that unit's contract
dataLifecycle.onTermination: destroy every unit's MariaDB datadir, passwd file and the Vault master key; nothing is exported

description: The minimal composition: Vault, Logger, Queue and Maestro, each a functional Podman with its own private MariaDB (Rules 4 and 26). No cognition adapter, no catalogue brick, no domain.

brick-vault.role: Protects secret material and delivers it to authorized callers

cognition.rationale: Deterministic secret storage and decryption. No model, ever.

brick-logger.role: Records events durably and proves what it received

cognition.rationale: Append-only structured evidence. No model, ever.

brick-queue.role: Durably holds deferred work until a terminal acknowledgement

cognition.rationale: Delivery is mechanical. Each job carries its own requirement, not the queue.

brick-maestro.role: Submits one idempotent occurrence to Queue for each due instant of a declared schedule; idle when none is declared

specialize.how: MAESTRO_TASKS_FILE points at this universe's task-schedule.json

cognition.rationale: Time, not orchestration: it computes due instants and submits typed jobs. It never executes work.
